items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Jake, a good pull with the conductor... he would just bring us all up... tell the conductor that we was his band

ctx.x: And Edward Clem had a, uh, uh, uh, Jake, a good pull with the conductor. Uh-huh. And he would just bring us all up, right, and tell the conductor that we was his band, and we didn't have to pay. He had a certain amount of price he paid for us, you see? Oh, he got a whole lot of money. And they would put tickets. When we'd get on the train, they'd make all the bands sit in one place, and put a little strip of tickets on your hat, just in your cap. That's so they'd recognize you.
Did you play on the train ever?
